missing: A direct answer: which specific portable power station (roughly 1–2 kWh class) to buy for a weekend with a given fridge type, at current prices, plus how to hook it to the RV (12V fridge socket vs 30A inlet) and how much solar or alternator charging covers day two.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all. The results are calculators and sizing explainers (rvingtoolbox, unpluggedwatts, campingcalc), three brand blogs (Renogy, FOSSiBOT, BLUETTI), a retailer install guide, affiliate guides, and an unreadable 2021 PDF. Only Volt & Valley gets to a size class with quick picks, and it is an untested affiliate niche site. A page that walks from fridge type to Wh/day to a named station with current prices and a tested code would be the only direct buying answer in the set.
